description.value: Fire resistance increases further; bonus to Fortitude against smoke inhalation and heat exhaustion.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Fire resistance increases further' states no new formula beyond Burn-Pit Blood's existing max(1,floor(@actor.level/2)), and 'bonus to Fortitude against smoke inhalation and heat exhaustion' has no matching trait/predicate. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
